title: Silver Nina
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After losing his job in Tokyo, Shutaro Shimazaki returns to his rural family home and finds a silver-haired, half-Japanese girl living there, his niece. The 15-volume iyashikei comedy follows the tired young man and the girl through slow, calming country life as he looks for work and they become family.
life_message: Caring for family and slowing down in a close community can restore a life that felt lost.
